# Pixel mascot — Style Prompt

> A friendly product-UI look on light grid paper: rounded app-icon tiles with a coloured bottom edge, each holding a tiny pixel-art mascot that steps through its frames and bobs a pixel; one big main-colour card with a chunky pixel-type title; a dark terminal panel where tagged lines (T01, T02) type in with dotted leaders and a green "done"; a white meter card with a giant pixel number and a filling band. Clean sans for everything else, crisp edges, soft lift shadows.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A **skin for a small business or creator, presented like a cute app**: the subject's items become a set of icon tiles with mascots (a cup, a bun, a leaf, a star, a heart), the workflow becomes terminal lines with numbered tags, the numbers become meters, the offer becomes one big coloured card. Cheerful, tidy, a little nerdy. It suits a cafe's new menu, an app or service launch, a creator's series list, a class's modules, a game-like checklist.

Not a retro game (no dithered world, no RPG dialogs, no CRT), not a flat illustration film (mascots are pixel sprites, everything else is clean UI), not a dashboard (one card or panel per scene, big type, lots of air).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Ground**: `--latar` with a square grid (54 px cells at 1080 wide, 1.5 px lines of ink at ~6 %).
- **Icon tile**: 220 px rounded square (radius 56) on `--latar-2`, a solid 12 px bottom edge in the tile's own colour, a soft lift shadow; a pixel mascot centred at ~76 % of the tile; a bold name and a muted one-word sub under it.
- **Pixel mascot**: a 12×12 sprite of 1-unit squares with crisp edges (`shape-rendering: crispEdges`), outlined in ink, 3–5 flat colours; 1–4 frames (steam, a blink, a flicker) switching every 0.25 s, the whole sprite bobbing one pixel on the off-beat.
- **Big card**: radius 44, flat `--utama` fill, the mascot top-left, the hero line in pixel type, one sentence, a dark chip tag.
- **Terminal**: radius 28, `--terminal` body with a lighter title bar, three coloured window dots, a centred muted title; mono lines, tags as small `--utama` rounded labels, dotted leaders, a green "beres", a block cursor.
- **Meter card**: white, radius 28, a giant pixel number, a muted label, a rounded progress band in `--aksen` on a 10 % ink track, mono captions at both ends.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` grid paper, `--latar-2` tiles and white cards; `--teks` names and big numbers, `--teks-redup` subs and labels.
- `--utama` is the big card, the tag labels and a tile edge; text on it is `--teks-di-utama`. The chip on the card inverts it (`--teks-di-utama` fill, `--utama` text).
- `--aksen` fills the meter band and a tile edge; `--aksen-di-latar` colours the second line of a pixel title.
- Fixed for the look: `--terminal` family (the panel is always dark), `--tinta` sprite outlines, `--kertas` sprite white, and sprite colours `--kopi`, `--roti`, `--daun`, `--hati` (also the window dots and some tile edges), so mascots read the same under any brand.
- Rule: one big colour field per scene; the rest is paper, white and the dark panel.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` is the pixel face for titles, prices and big numbers (VT323 by default; Press Start 2P for a chunkier, smaller line), uppercase titles at 140–170 px, prices at 200–230 px, meter numbers at 260 px, line height 0.85–0.9; the second title line in the accent.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 600/800) for tile names (34 px 800), subs (26 px), card sentences (46 px), body lines (40 px).
- Mono (IBM Plex Mono) only inside the terminal, chips and meter captions, 26–38 px.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Sprites**: frames every 0.25 s, a one-pixel bob alternating with neighbours, driven by the timeline clock.
- **Tiles**: pop from scale 0 and 40 px down, 0.4 s `back.out(2.2)`, staggered 0.12 s; a chosen tile pulses to 1.12 and back (0.25 s).
- **Panels and cards**: rise 100–120 px with a fade in 0.4–0.45 s `back.out(1.4)`.
- **Terminal lines**: one per 0.7 s; the tag pops (0.2 s `back.out(3)`), the line slides 30 px in, the dotted leader fills in 9 steps (`steps(9)`, 0.35 s), then "beres" snaps on; the block cursor blinks at 0.25 s.
- **Numbers**: count up in 1.4 s `power2.out` with the band filling in sync; a 1.04 bump on landing.
- **Prices**: slam from 1.6× in 0.3 s `circ.out`; the chip sticks on with a −8° twist and `back.out(2.5)`.
- **CTA pill**: breathes to 1.05 at 0.35 s per half.
- Cuts are hard; no camera moves, no fades between scenes.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame, tile grid | the whole range at a glance | a menu; a product line; a series; class modules |
| Panel rising into frame | "here is how it works" | an ordering flow; a booking; a checklist |
| Pixel title slam | the headline | "menu baru"; "episode 5"; "kelas dibuka" |
| Meter card with count-up | proof in numbers | cups sold; sign-ups; streak days |
| Big colour card | the offer, alone | a price; a bundle; a free trial |
| Mascot hero with name | sign-off | the shop's name and chat; a channel handle |

## 7. Native moves

- **The tile drop.** Six icon tiles pop in one by one, each mascot already stepping and bobbing; the title lands below in pixel type. *Fits content like:* a cafe's six new drinks; a creator's six video series; six modules of a class; six services of a laundry.
- **Tagged terminal.** Lines with T01, T02, T03 tags type in, dotted leaders fill, green "beres" lands, the cursor blinks on the last one. *Fits content like:* order → paid → delivered; "edit, upload, reply comments"; a lesson's three steps; a story told as a log.
- **Pixel meter.** A giant pixel number counts up with a band and a percent. *Fits content like:* "128 gelas sebelum jam 10"; "30 hari beruntun"; "1.200 murid"; "80% stok terjual".
- **The yellow card.** The mascot, a price slammed in pixel type, one sentence, a dark chip. *Fits content like:* "Rp18rb" breakfast bundle; "Gratis" first class; "Rp49rb/bln" membership; a creator's preset pack.
- **Mascot sign-off.** The big mascot, the name in two pixel lines, an address line, a dark chat pill with a tag that breathes. *Fits content like:* a shop's chat; a channel's follow line; a class sign-up; a game night invite.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Blurry sprites: always crisp edges, whole-unit squares, no scaling that smooths; keep sprites at multiples of 12 px.
- Too many sprites moving out of step: one clock drives all frames; bobs alternate, never random.
- Pixel type for body text: pixel face only for titles, prices and numbers; sentences in the sans.
- A light terminal: the panel stays dark whatever the brand; tags take the brand's main colour.
- Crowding: one panel or card per scene, with paper around it.
- A sprite whose colours vanish on a brand's ground: sprites keep their own ink outline and fixed colours.

# Pixel mascot: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3, long 3.4.

## hook

- en: a grid of app-icon tiles pops in one by one, each with a bobbing pixel mascot and a name; a pixel-type title follows
- id: ubin ikon aplikasi meletup satu per satu, tiap ubin maskot piksel yang memantul dan nama; judul huruf piksel menyusul

## problem

- en: a dark terminal line with a red-dot bar types the problem; the mascot's frame stops and a grey tag says 'tertunda'
- id: baris terminal gelap mengetik masalahnya; maskot berhenti bergerak dan tag abu-abu menulis 'tertunda'

## fact

- en: a white card with one fact in pixel type and a small mascot tile beside it, popped with a back ease
- id: kartu putih dengan satu fakta huruf piksel dan ubin maskot kecil di sampingnya, meletup dengan pantulan

## step

- en: a terminal panel; tagged lines T01, T02 appear one per beat, dotted leaders fill in steps, then 'beres' in green
- id: panel terminal; baris bertag T01, T02 muncul per ketukan, titik-titik terisi bertahap, lalu 'beres' hijau

## compare

- en: two icon tiles side by side with names; the better one's coloured edge glows and its mascot bobs, the other stays still
- id: dua ubin ikon berdampingan dengan nama; tepi berwarna yang lebih baik menyala dan maskotnya memantul, yang lain diam

## number

- en: a white meter card: a giant pixel-type number counts up, a progress band fills, a mono percent follows
- id: kartu meter putih: angka huruf piksel raksasa dihitung naik, pita kemajuan terisi, persen huruf mono ikut

## proof

- en: a column of terminal lines with green checks, each with a T-number tag, the mascot tile beside them
- id: kolom baris terminal bercentang hijau, tiap baris bertag nomor T, ubin maskot di sampingnya

## offer

- en: a big main-colour card: the mascot, the price slammed in pixel type, one line of detail, a dark chip tag
- id: kartu besar warna utama: maskot, harga huruf piksel menghentak, satu baris detail, chip gelap

## cta

- en: the big mascot, the name in pixel type, an address line, a dark pill with a chat tag that pulses; held 2 s
- id: maskot besar, nama huruf piksel, baris alamat, tombol gelap bertag chat yang berdenyut; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the tile grid returns with every mascot bobbing, one pixel-type closing line under it; held 2 s
- id: kisi ubin kembali dengan semua maskot memantul, satu kalimat penutup huruf piksel di bawahnya; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Maskot piksel</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "VT323"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Sisanya milik gaya ini:
         panel terminal selalu gelap, warna sprite (kopi, roti, daun) tetap supaya maskotnya tetap terbaca. */
      :root {
        --latar: #eef0f3; --latar-2: #ffffff; --utama: #f2cf1d; --aksen: #5b7cfa;
        --teks: #1d1f24; --teks-redup: #6b7280; --teks-di-utama: #1d1f24;
        --teks-di-aksen: #ffffff; --utama-di-latar: #8a6d00; --aksen-di-latar: #3f5fe0;
        --font-judul: "VT323", "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --terminal: #23252b; --terminal-2: #2d3038; --terminal-teks: #e8e8e6; --terminal-redup: #8d919a;
        --tinta: #1d1f24; --kertas: #ffffff; --kopi: #8a5a3c; --roti: #e8a65a; --daun: #58b368; --hati: #ef5b6b;
        --kisi: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 6%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi);
        background-color: var(--latar);
        background-image: linear-gradient(var(--kisi) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--kisi) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px);
        background-size: 54px 54px; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      svg.sp { shape-rendering: crispEdges; overflow: visible; }
      .p-o { fill: var(--tinta); } .p-w { fill: var(--kertas); } .p-b { fill: var(--kopi); } .p-y { fill: var(--utama); }
      .p-s { fill: var(--terminal-redup); } .p-m { fill: var(--roti); } .p-g { fill: var(--daun); } .p-h { fill: var(--hati); }
      .p-a { fill: var(--aksen); }
      /* Ubin ikon: kotak membulat putih, tepi bawah berwarna, sprite di tengah, nama di bawah. */
      .ubin { position: absolute; width: 220px; text-align: center; }
      .ubin .kotak { width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 56px; background: var(--latar-2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 0 var(--tepi, var(--utama)), 0 14px 30px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 12%, transparent); }
      .ubin b { display: block; margin-top: 30px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 34px; }
      .ubin small { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .judul { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 150px; line-height: 0.9; text-align: center;
        text-transform: uppercase; }
      .judul .k { color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      .isi { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      /* Panel terminal gelap. */
      .term { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--terminal); color: var(--terminal-teks);
        font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 24px 50px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta) 30%, transparent); }
      .term .bar { height: 70px; background: var(--terminal-2); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 28px; }
      .term .bar i { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--hati); }
      .term .bar i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--utama); } .term .bar i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--daun); }
      .term .bar span { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 26px; color: var(--terminal-redup); margin-right: 80px; }
      .baris { position: relative; padding: 0 40px; margin-top: 34px; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.45; white-space: nowrap; }
      .tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-weight: 600; margin-right: 14px; }
      .redup { color: var(--terminal-redup); }
      .ok { color: var(--daun); font-weight: 600; }
      .kursor { display: inline-block; width: 18px; height: 34px; background: var(--terminal-teks); vertical-align: -6px; }
      /* Kartu besar berwarna utama. */
      .kartu { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; border-radius: 44px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); padding: 70px; }
      .kartu .harga { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 230px; line-height: 0.85; margin-top: 40px; }
      .kartu p { font-weight: 600; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 30px; }
      .kartu .chip { display: inline-block; margin-top: 40px; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--teks-di-utama); color: var(--utama);
        font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 32px; }
      /* Pita meter. */
      .meter { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--latar-2); padding: 50px 56px;
        box-shadow: 0 14px 30px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent); }
      .meter .angka { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 260px; line-height: 0.85; color: var(--teks); }
      .meter .label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 38px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .rel { position: relative; height: 26px; margin-top: 34px; border-radius: 13px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, transparent); overflow: hidden; }
      .rel i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--aksen); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .rel-ket { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 14px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-size: 28px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .wa { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 26px 50px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--terminal); color: var(--terminal-teks);
        font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 38px; white-space: nowrap; }
      .wa .tag { font-size: 30px; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="ubin" style="left: 110px; top: 260px; --tepi: var(--kopi)"><div class="kotak"><svg class="sp" data-sp="cangkir" width="168" height="168"></svg></div><b>Kopi</b><small>gula aren</small></div>
        <div class="ubin" style="left: 430px; top: 260px; --tepi: var(--roti)"><div class="kotak"><svg class="sp" data-sp="roti" width="168" height="168"></svg></div><b>Roti</b><small>mentega</small></div>
        <div class="ubin" style="left: 750px; top: 260px; --tepi: var(--daun)"><div class="kotak"><svg class="sp" data-sp="daun" width="168" height="168"></svg></div><b>Teh</b><small>melati</small></div>
        <div class="ubin" style="left: 110px; top: 690px; --tepi: var(--aksen)"><div class="kotak"><svg class="sp" data-sp="bintang" width="168" height="168"></svg></div><b>Promo</b><small>pagi</small></div>
        <div class="ubin" style="left: 430px; top: 690px; --tepi: var(--hati)"><div class="kotak"><svg class="sp" data-sp="hati" width="168" height="168"></svg></div><b>Favorit</b><small>pelanggan</small></div>
        <div class="ubin" style="left: 750px; top: 690px; --tepi: var(--utama)"><div class="kotak"><svg class="sp" data-sp="cangkir" width="168" height="168"></svg></div><b>Es kopi</b><small>susu</small></div>
        <div class="judul" style="top: 1210px">Menu baru<br /><span class="k">pagi ini</span></div>
        <div class="isi" style="top: 1520px">Enam menu, satu kedai, pesan dari HP.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <div class="judul" style="top: 190px">Pesan<br /><span class="k">1 menit</span></div>
        <div class="term" style="top: 560px; height: 760px">
          <div class="bar"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span>kedai-nana — pesanan</span></div>
          <div class="baris" id="b1"><span class="tag">T01</span>kopi susu gula aren<br /><span class="redup">··················</span> <span class="ok">beres</span></div>
          <div class="baris" id="b2"><span class="tag">T02</span>roti mentega hangat<br /><span class="redup">··················</span> <span class="ok">beres</span></div>
          <div class="baris" id="b3"><span class="tag">T03</span>antar ke meja 4<br /><span class="redup">ambil 12 menit lagi</span> <span class="kursor" id="kursor"></span></div>
          <svg class="sp" data-sp="cangkir" width="150" height="150" style="position: absolute; right: 50px; bottom: 50px"></svg>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div class="judul" style="top: 240px">Hari ini</div>
        <div class="meter" style="top: 560px">
          <div class="angka" id="angka">0</div>
          <div class="label">gelas terjual sebelum jam 10</div>
          <div class="rel"><i id="isi-rel"></i></div>
          <div class="rel-ket"><span>stok 160</span><span id="persen">0%</span></div>
        </div>
        <svg class="sp" data-sp="cangkir" width="300" height="300" style="position: absolute; left: 390px; top: 1290px"></svg>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="offer">
        <div class="kartu" style="top: 330px; height: 1180px">
          <svg class="sp" data-sp="bintang" width="180" height="180"></svg>
          <div class="harga" id="harga">Rp18rb</div>
          <p>Kopi susu gula aren + roti mentega, sampai jam 10 pagi.</p>
          <div class="chip">T04 · promo pagi</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s5" data-role="cta">
        <svg class="sp" data-sp="cangkir" width="360" height="360" style="position: absolute; left: 360px; top: 260px"></svg>
        <div class="judul" style="top: 760px; font-size: 140px">Kedai<br /><span class="k">Seduh Nana</span></div>
        <div class="isi" style="top: 1060px">Jl. Kenanga 12 · buka 07.00–21.00</div>
        <div class="wa" id="wa" style="top: 1260px"><span class="tag">Chat</span>0812-3456-7890</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      // ---- Sprite piksel 12×12. Huruf = warna (kelas .p-x), titik = kosong. Cangkir punya uap empat bingkai.
      const UAP = [[3, 6], [4, 7], [3, 7], [2, 6]];
      function cangkir(f) {
        const u = UAP[f], up = (y) => Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, x) => (u.includes(x + (y % 2 ? 1 : 0)) ? "s" : ".")).join("");
        return [up(0), up(1), up(2), "............", ".oooooooo...", ".obbbbbbo...", ".owwwwwwooo.", ".owwwwwwo.o.", ".oyyyyyyo.o.", ".owwwwwwooo.", "..owwwwo....", "...oooo....."];
      }
      const SPRITE = {
        cangkir: [0, 1, 2, 3].map(cangkir),
        roti: [["............", "............", "....oooo....", "..oommmmoo..", ".ommmmmmmmo.", "ommwmmmwmmmo", "ommmmmmmmmmo", ".ommmmmmmmo.", "..oooooooo..", "............"]],
        daun: [[".....oo.....", "....ogo.....", "...oggo.....", "..ogggo.....", "..oggwgo....", "..ogggwgo...", "...ogggggo..", "....oooooo..", ".....o......", "....o......."]],
        bintang: [["............", ".....o......", "....oyo.....", "oooooyyoooo.", ".oyyyyyyyo..", "..oyyyyyo...", ".oyyoooyyo..", ".oo.....oo..", "............"]],
        hati: [["............", ".oo...oo....", "ohho.ohho...", "ohwhohhhho..", "ohhhhhhhho..", ".ohhhhhhho..", "..ohhhhho...", "...ohhho....", "....oho.....", ".....o......"]],
      };
      const bingkai = [];
      document.querySelectorAll("svg.sp").forEach((svg) => {
        const frames = SPRITE[svg.dataset.sp];
        svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 -1 12 13");
        const gs = frames.map((rows, i) => {
          const g = document.createElementNS(NS, "g");
          const top = Math.floor((12 - rows.length) / 2);
          rows.forEach((row, y) => [...row].forEach((c, x) => {
            if (c === ".") return;
            const r = document.createElementNS(NS, "rect");
            r.setAttribute("x", x); r.setAttribute("y", y + top); r.setAttribute("width", 1.02); r.setAttribute("height", 1.02);
            r.setAttribute("class", `p-${c}`);
            g.appendChild(r);
          }));
          if (i) g.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
          return svg.appendChild(g);
        });
        bingkai.push({ svg, gs, cur: 0 });
      });
      // Satu jam untuk semua sprite: bingkai berganti tiap 0,25 dtk, badan memantul satu piksel. Ditentukan waktu, bukan timer.
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => {
        const n = Math.floor(jam.t / 0.25);
        bingkai.forEach((b, i) => {
          const f = n % b.gs.length;
          if (f !== b.cur) { b.gs[b.cur].setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"); b.gs[f].setAttribute("visibility", "inherit"); b.cur = f; }
          b.svg.style.transform = (n + i) % 2 ? "translateY(-6px)" : "none";
        });
      } }, 0);
